summary: Tested new Virtual/Physical slot + Society features end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 new tests pass (societies CRUD, provider mixed-slot create/update persistence as objects, booking validation for physical without society (400), physical with non-offered society (400), physical valid, virtual valid with society_id=null, invalid time slot). Frontend: full flows on Chromium desktop - Admin created society appears in /manage/admin/societies list; Provider modal builder adds physical+virtual slots and saves; Edit dialog correctly loads existing slots (2 rows) and available_days; Customer checkout dynamic steps validated: virtual slot skips address step and lands on /app/bookings after confirm; physical slot reveals society picker (4 options for seeded slot), 'Continue' correctly disabled until a society is picked, address step appears, booking persists (My bookings shows both new subscriptions).
action_items: Optional: delete or refactor legacy /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py - 3 stale assertions fail after schema change (categories count hard-coded to 10 but seeded is 8/9; two booking tests still send physical mode with no society_id and expect 200). Not real regressions but noisy in CI.
Prior iteration_2 issues about Cart 'Proceed' z-index and post-confirm redirect appear resolved (Checkout.jsx now navigates to /app/bookings after success).
critical_code_review_comments: SlotConfig.mode has no enum validation - any string accepted; add Literal['physical','virtual'] to prevent bad data.
POST /api/bookings validates society_id membership using slot_cfg.societies but does not require slot presence when svc has no slots array (legacy fallback path). Fine for now.
server.py still monolithic ~700 lines; consider splitting into routers.
PUT /provider/services rewrites all item IDs (same as flagged in iter 2) and always resets status='pending'.
Frontend Checkout: `absolute bottom-0 ... max-w-md mx-auto` on CTA bar - on desktop viewport the sticky CTA is centered but the checkout page uses full width; verify mobile-first spec is intended.
Good: SlotConfig model added; slots persisted as objects; society validation returns 400 with helpful message.
test_credentials: Pre-seeded sessions in mongo: admin=test_session_admin_001 (user_adminseed01), customer=test_session_cust_001 (user_custseed01). Provider session created this iteration: test_session_prov_001 -> user_demoprov_fit.
seed_data_creation: Added provider session test_session_prov_001 mapped to seeded user_demoprov_fit. All TEST_* societies/services/bookings created during tests were cleaned up (mongosh deleteMany at end).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new virtual/physical/society features working end-to-end. Selectors used: slot-time-select, slot-mode-physical, slot-mode-virtual, draft-society-<socId>, add-slot-button, save-service-button, slot-row-<mode>-<time>, edit-service-<svcId>, society-name-input, society-area-input, create-society-button, society-item-<socId>, plan-<id>, plan-continue, slot-<mode>-<time>, society-<socId>, slot-continue, checkout-address-input, address-continue, confirm-booking-button. After confirm booking, navigation goes to /app/bookings correctly. Legacy backend_test.py has 3 stale failures - unrelated to current features.
rca of the issue: No new bugs found in this iteration.
